title: CSM make-tests suite config namespace
description: Bounded generation-preference settings for the csm-make-tests namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only dimension selection and file budgets are configurable; write scope, ledger authority, approval ledgers, mutation gates, verification contracts, credentials, and lifecycle are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

testDimensions.description: Which test dimensions to prioritize during generation; per-run intent and coverage requirements can still widen this. Arrays replace wholesale at the resolver layer.

maxFiles.description: Upper bound on generated test files per package; a ceiling preference, not a write-scope grant.
